issues.title: 1.1.7 loaded after Viewpoint 0.1.7: the game closes while it loads the mods
issues.note: With Viewpoint 0.1.7 (2026-11-15) loaded first, the game class zombie.SandboxOptions is already loaded when this addon's Java patches it (getWaterShutModifier, doesPowerGridExist), so ZombieBuddy (2.3.4) re-patches it and starts it before Lua exists: NullPointerException ('thread is null'), ExceptionInInitializerError, then 'GameThread exited'. It worked on 42.22.2 with Viewpoint 0.1.6 (2026-11-12). Loaded before Viewpoint, the game started and loaded a save once (2026-11-16); Viewpoint then switched itself off in that session, but because of Viewpoint - Light Fix, which fails at start with Viewpoint 0.1.7 whatever this addon does. Exhaustive Power Rework itself does not need this addon: switching it off is the sure fix; loading it before Viewpoint was seen to work once.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, seen three times in console.txt on 42.22.2 with ZombieBuddy 2.3.4 when loaded after Viewpoint; one session loaded before it started (2026-11-16)

issues.title: getKey(nil) on every key press
issues.note: FHbindings[1] is a header with no value, and FHhandleKeybinds asks core:getKey for every entry on each key press: Java throws a NullPointerException ("keybindID" is null) and logs it, hundreds of times a session (holding the right mouse button adds more). The Studio's shim answers getKey(nil) with nil without asking Java (part 6, the guards on the game's own code), as the game would after logging; the mod works the same. Checked in the game on 42.21, 2026-10-30.
issues.log: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "zombie.input.KeybindId.getId()" because "keybindID" is null at zombie.core.Core.getKey(Core.java:3023)
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, verified in the game's console.txt on 42.21 (2026-10-30)

issues.title: Hidden indicators take the clicks at the top-left of the screen
issues.note: Auto-hidden indicators are moved to -20000 and kept visible; 42.21 keeps top-level UI on the screen (ISUIElement:setX clamps to 0), so they pile up at 0,0, invisible, over the equipped-item icons: right-clicking the primary hand does nothing. The Studio's shim lets them leave the screen while hidden (patch modern_status). Checked in the game on 42.21, 2026-10-30: 22 indicators at 0,0, none after the patch.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, checked in the game on 42.21 (2026-10-30)

issues.title: findAimTarget calls getMaxRange on an item that is not a weapon
issues.note: Its OnPlayerUpdate handler keeps looking for a tank to shoot while an attack is under way, even when the item in the hand is not a firearm; findAimTarget then calls weapon:getMaxRange(), which only weapons have. The Studio's shim answers no target when the hand holds no ranged weapon (patch propane_explosion). Reproduced and checked in the game on 42.21, 2026-10-30.
issues.log: ERROR: General f:188498> Lua((MOD:Propane Explosion)).findAimTarget> Exception thrown java.lang.RuntimeException: Object tried to call nil in findAimTarget
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, checked in the game on 42.21 (2026-10-30)

issues.title: 0.1.7: ZombieBuddy left it out until its author re-uploaded it unsigned (2026-11-16), and its addons took the game or server down
issues.note: The first 0.1.7 jar (Workshop update of 2026-11-15) was signed with a key its author's Steam profile does not show, so ZombieBuddy left Viewpoint out ('invalid ZBS') and addons built on it failed at boot with NoClassDefFoundError viewpoint/...; one exposed to Lua stopped the game or the server. On 2026-11-16 the author re-uploaded 0.1.7 without a signature: after Steam updates it, it loads. A copy the Studio made in Zomboid/mods before that still carries the old Viewpoint.jar.zbs: Mod Health offers to copy it again. If ZombieBuddy still leaves it out with 'blocked by policy=prompt', a "don't allow" for that jar was saved during the broken hours: hold Shift while the game loads and allow it in ZombieBuddy's window (the Studio never edits that file).
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, seen in a server's server-console.txt on 42.22 (2026-11-16)

issues.title: 0.1.7: crashes while preparing or building the scene with old addons carried along
issues.note: Players report Viewpoint 0.1.7 crashing ('Crashed while: preparing' or 'building the scene'). The advice shared by its players: switch off the old addons it carries along, in Viewpoint's own settings, the lines addons.legacyCarried.legacy_... set to 1 (legacy_dry_cure, legacy_fletcherarcheryfixes, legacy_pzvoxelstudioviewpoint, legacy_viewpointfences3d, legacy_viewpointlivingprops, legacy_viewpointvisibleloot): set them to 0. A 'Failed to compile shader: version 130 is not supported' line is the graphics driver, not the mod list.
issues.source: Reported by players of the mod, 2026-11-16
